method: built-in image_gen edits of existing art
status: Prepared derivatives; Lucas framing judgment remains pending in task16. Original creative statuses are unchanged.
rejectedAttempt: First outputs baked a checkerboard into RGB. Corrected to opaque charcoal portraits; no runtime transparency/crop dependency.

records.prompt: Use case: identity-preserve. Asset: production memorial portrait for RPG Maker game. Edit target: attached Dryland_H1.png. Create ONE tightly framed head and upper shoulders portrait from this exact existing drawing. Preserve the original face identity, expression, head angle, hair/headgear, black sketch lines and flat parchment tan fill exactly; do not redesign, embellish, recolor, add shadows or add a frame. Portrait canvas aspect ratio 4:5, with the whole head including ears/hair/hat and a small margin at top, face centered, upper shoulders at bottom. Transparent background outside the existing character silhouette, preserve alpha; no white background, no text, no border. This is a framing derivative of the existing artwork, not new character art. Output PNG.
records.backgroundCorrection: Edit only the background of this memorial portrait: replace ALL checkerboard/grid pixels outside the character with perfectly uniform opaque charcoal color #24221b. No checkerboard anywhere. Keep every character line, face, expression, clothing, composition and dimensions unchanged. No other changes, no texture, no gradients, no new frame, no text. The deliverable is intentionally opaque, a finished charcoal-background portrait ready for the game's memorial.
